'''Star Tours Flight 1209''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight arriving at [[Spaceport THX1138]] from [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]]. At the time of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight had arrived on time at 0650 hours at Gate 1M and was boarding passengers in preparation for its departure at 0745.
